name: Dragonwrack
body:
Your righteous power is even more effective against dragons than that of your peers.

Prerequisite: Paladin

Benefit: Whenever you deal damage to a dragon who is the target of your smite evil ability, it becomes dazed for one round unless it succeeds on a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + ½ your paladin level + your Charisma modifier).
